prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a weathered street sign, with the word "Mortlake" prominently displayed in bold red letters against a white background. The sign is partially framed by black metal bars, suggesting it is mounted on a gate or fence. The upper portion of the sign shows remnants of black text, partially cropped out of the frame, adding a sense of age and use. The surface of the sign is slightly worn, with faint marks and scratches visible, and a single metal rivet secures it in the lower right corner. The background is softly blurred, featuring hints of green foliage and muted natural tones, creating a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the sign itself. The lighting is natural and diffuse, evoking an overcast day and lending a subdued, realistic atmosphere to the scene. The overall composition is tight and focused, emphasizing the text and texture of the sign, with a documentary or cinematic realism in style.
